contentPinInventoryD.cause: The committed ordinary-review reports are descendants of the inventory content pin, so the committed-review lookup correctly refuses them as future evidence for that snapshot.

finalPinInventory.change: The impact-analysis capability gate was added after the content pin.

conflict: L10-41 reasons only from unchanged docs/** bytes, but AGENTS.md is also an identity-scope authority source and changed between the sole registry sync and the committed review. Therefore no allowed run can both preserve the no-second-carry instruction and produce a final-pin inventory whose D/E accepts the review reports.
stopRuleApplied: The close stopped before strict E, comparator regeneration, promotion, H, T9, audit/replay/ownership/A/B/I/alias checks, relevant tests, final scorecard, or transition to awaiting owner review. No pass was inferred or fabricated.
requiredResolution: An authorized follow-up must either permit one native carry-forward/registry persistence at a commit containing the review reports, or change the governing evidence model/checker in a separately reviewed change. This turn has authority for neither.
